## Checklist

- [ ] It meets the 80/20 rule in CONTRIBUTING.md: among the top 20% of its kind and useful to 80% of Clyde users.
- [ ] It is one unit of work: related enhancements together (such as a set of rules for one kind of transaction) or one fix. Unrelated changes go in their own pull request.
- [ ] `npm ci`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, and `npm run validate` pass on my machine.
- [ ] A new rule has a sample for each form its statement text takes, and sits above any general rule it overlaps.
- [ ] A new or changed entry follows its kind's section in CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] I license this contribution under the repo's Apache-2.0 license.
